symbols.note: from gatekit symbols system --dll dx11 --full; no per-method address was found in bg3_dx11.exe (null)
symbols.limits: reads/writes: the component views in the parameters of the system's exported methods. uses: the component operations (add, remove, get, has) its per-frame update performs through the engine's out-of-line helpers, itself or in a function it calls (depth 2), with the call site; kind index: a matched method reads the type's index and the operation is not known. Not listed: operations the compiler inlined, those deeper than depth 2, and what a method that is not the update does (e.g. a SystemLoad) - read its pseudo-code; an empty writes list is not "writes nothing".

does.text: Each frame: ProcessGameStateEvents, then GetCampSupplyEntity to find (or make) the one camp-supply entity, then ProcessNewSupplies; ProcessCampQualityChanges and ProcessTotalSuppliesChanges run only when that entity handle is valid.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x9DCF50 named pseudo-code, lines 47-56 read whole (short function).
does.check: not checkable live: the order of calls inside one update leaves nothing to observe

does.text: Looks for entities holding eoc::camp::TotalSuppliesComponent ('More than one CampSupply entity found!' if several). When none is found and a system byte (+0x30) is set, it logs 'Creating new entity', creates an entity through the deferred command buffer and adds eoc::camp::TotalSuppliesComponent, eoc::camp::QualityComponent, esv::camp::InitializeQualityComponent, ls::IsGlobalComponent and ls::SavegameComponent to it. Review 2026-11-14 (Opus, systems I): the run branch's earlier text (from bg3_dx11.exe) had "two further things not identified": they are ls::IsGlobalComponent and ls::SavegameComponent.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x9D86A0 named pseudo-code, lines 108-349 read: DAT_182230058 = query on TotalSuppliesComponent; guard at line 226-227 (handle invalid and this[0x30] != 0); CreateEntity line 264; add helpers +0x9D19B0 (DAT_18222f904 TotalSuppliesComponent), +0x9D13E0 (DAT_18222f908 QualityComponent), +0x9D11F0 (DAT_182230054 InitializeQualityComponent), +0x2DB590 (ls::IsGlobalComponent), +0x2DAC40 (ls::SavegameComponent), each helper's frame-storage type resolved. Same in bg3_dx11.exe: +0x2C0BE50 (called from +0x238E9A0), the three adds inline there; +0x2707770 and +0x2707670 only get or make the frame storage of Quality and InitializeQuality; the query spec at +0x3E49D0 is the single type TotalSuppliesComponent.
does.check: not checkable live: no recipe yet (lead): on a new game, or after a story reload destroyed the supply entity, {appears: esv::camp::InitializeQualityComponent} on the server within a few ticks; a recipe from the copy's checkpoint finds the entity already made

does.text: When no SetCampQuality story request is pending (byte +0x38 clear), removes esv::camp::InitializeQualityComponent from every entity that has it - so the marker lives from the creation frame until the next pass. A pending request (LEGACY_SetCampQuality stores the level at +0x34 and sets +0x38) is applied: 'SetCampQuality request processed', 'changing quality level from (%d) to (%d)', 'changing required supplies from (%d) to (%d)'.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x9D91F0 lines 188-283 read (DAT_1822300bc = query on InitializeQualityComponent; RemoveComponentUnchecked of DAT_182230054 at line 271); the quality branch from log strings at 551-660; EoCServer.dll+0x9D8EF0 lines 46-49.
does.check: not checkable live: the remove follows the creation by about one frame, and the creation has no recipe (see GetCampSupplyEntity)

does.text: Keeps eoc::camp::SupplyComponent on items that count as camp supplies: re-evaluates all supply entities or one whose stats were reloaded, removes SupplyComponent when an item no longer counts ('Removing SupplyComponent'), updates its value, or attaches it with a value ('Attaching SupplyComponent to (%s) with value of (%d)'), and adds esv::camp::SuppliesUpdatedEventOneFrameComponent.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x9DA5F0 log strings at 249-685, RemoveComponentUnchecked of DAT_18222f420 (SupplyComponent) at 557, add helpers +0x9D17D0 (SupplyComponent) at 717 and +0x9D15E0 (SuppliesUpdatedEventOneFrameComponent) at 766; what makes an item count was not read.
does.check: not checkable live: no recipe adds a supply item to the party yet (lead: pick up a camp supply item, {appears: eoc::camp::SupplyComponent} on it)

does.text: When a supply item changes owner or a character changes party, decides whether the change moves it in or out of the party's stock ('Previous Owner was a party member and new is not' and the reverse), then recounts and writes the total ('Updated total number of supplies from (%d) to (%d)').
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x9DB7A0 log strings 256-805, GatherTotalSupplyCount called at line 730.
does.check: not checkable live: eoc::camp::TotalSuppliesComponent field names are not read here; no recipe moves a supply item between owners

does.text: On session unload, or when a reload-story flag is set (LEGACY_RequestReloadStory sets +0x33), destroys the camp-supply entity ('destroying CampSupply entity').
does.check: not checkable live: a session unload or story reload ends the recipe
